one_sentence_story: You feel groggy after hitting snooze because the survival base of your brain wakes up in seconds, while the smart planner behind your forehead takes up to thirty minutes to turn back on.
so_what_for_you: Stop making big choices in the first twenty minutes awake, ditch the five-alarm snooze chain, and step into bright morning light right after your feet hit the floor.
